title: Unique Smoky Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: Charred and shattering Brazilian chicken skewers with a cozy twist, featuring white vinegar and mantecare emulsify, all paleo-friendly, this dish brings a taste of Brazil to your table with its smoky and savory flavors.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together white vinegar, coconut oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
While the chicken is cooking, mix the chopped parsley and cilantro in a small bowl.
Once the chicken is done, brush the skewers with the parsley and cilantro mixture.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
